title: NIST AI 600-1 RMF Generative AI Profile: Council of AI Compliance Mapping
context: 2026-08-27 engine cycle -- NIST released AI 600-1 (Generative AI Profile) requiring organisations to map GenAI risks through the full AI RMF 1.0 framework
body: The NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile, published as NIST's first formal GenAI risk-management annex to AI RMF 1.0, demands organisations demonstrate auditable governance across twelve GenAI-specific risk categories including confabulation, data provenance, information integrity, and CBRN information barriers. The Council of AI compliance mapping overlays a verified measurement credential on each category: instead of self-attestation, operators publish a signed measurement record of their GenAI risk posture — what was tested, by which model, on which board, with what score. This converts the NIST requirement from a paper exercise into a continuously verifiable signal. The mapping covers: (1) confabulation risk → verified hallucination benchmarks with per-model scores; (2) data provenance → training-data attestation chains with cryptographic hashes; (3) information integrity → output-watermarking verification; (4) CBRN barriers → detector-interoperability board scores. Organisations adopting this mapping can answer 'show me your NIST AI 600-1 conformance' with a signed, machine-readable measurement card rather than a consultant's PDF. The Council maintains this mapping as a living document at councilofai.org/nist-600-1.
references: Council of AI Verified Measurement Credential standard
